purpose: Compare the two first milestone candidates on identical fresh development seeds before further model changes.
comparison: Mean paired accuracy difference over 30 shared seeds for each family, final B probe, and first 100 predictions after both switches.

bootstrap.interval: descriptive percentile 95%, paired by seed, no multiplicity adjustment

interpretation: A criterion pass is not evidence of novelty or statistical significance. Development and evaluation rule families are public. Timing is diagnostic and heap memory is not measured.
